cards.text: Friend, we're opening a letter! It's from Paul, called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus, writing with our brother Sosthenes to the church of God in Corinth. And look, he puts his name right up top, not like those texts that just say 'hey' from a number you never saved.

cards.question: Paul says he became an apostle of Christ Jesus by his own choice.

cards.text: Paul doesn't just call them a church. He tells them who they are: sanctified in Christ Jesus.

cards.question: Paul says the Corinthians are sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be ___.

cards.text: Then Paul widens the greeting to all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours. That's a group chat with NO member limit, and then comes the greeting: grace and peace!

cards.question: Paul's letter to the church in Corinth says, "Grace and peace to you…" Who does he say the grace and peace come from?

answers.text: God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ
All the churches of Christ everywhere

cards.text: Next, Paul says he ALWAYS thanks his God for them. ALWAYS, friend. I once took three days to thank a baker for scrubbing my mixer, and I was PROUD of myself.

cards.question: Paul, who just wished the Corinthians grace, says he thanks his God for them because of the grace God has given them in Christ Jesus.

cards.text: Paul says that in Christ they've been enriched in EVERY way. Friend, the richest thing in my old junk drawer was an expired coupon, and it still carried itself like a millionaire.

cards.question: Paul names two ways the Corinthians have been enriched in Christ. What are they?

answers.text: In all speech and all knowledge

cards.text: Paul tells them why it happened: "because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you."

cards.question: Because of all this, Paul says the Corinthians do not lack any ___ gift.
While they have every spiritual gift, Paul says the Corinthians are eagerly waiting for someone to be revealed. Who?

cards.text: Not snooze-button waiting, friend, EAGER waiting. And Paul says He will sustain them to the end.

cards.question: Paul says the Corinthians will be sustained to the end so that they will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

cards.text: Then Paul points them to God Himself, the One who called them into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord.

cards.question: After promising they'll be sustained to the end, Paul says the God who called the Corinthians into fellowship with His Son is ___.
